scope: Post-training reference-only numerical common-frame discrepancy; not a calibrated geometric accuracy claim or source authority decision
crop_membership: half-open on all axes; fixed P3 region before evaluation
metrics: Native prediction-to-reference and reference-to-prediction nearest distances with all in-crop points retained
Fixed-domain and reference-occupied XY cell coverage with missing counts
Signed median-Z differences in common XY cells, with missing denominator recorded
Each B arm own initial and final surfaces, plus reference errors on the same triple-common cells
limits: UAS datum, epoch and measurement precision are not newly calibrated
Raw UAS is evaluation-only and must not be used by A judgment or B training
No registration fitting, error-based filtering, reference-driven crop or parameter selection
2.5D XY median is not roof, wall, window or semantic detail truth
Point maps and cross sections are diagnostic figures; actual camera renders are separate B artifacts
